title: OpenAI Engineer Arrested for Bugging Office, Company Says AI Caught Him
summary: A Saudi national working at OpenAI allegedly hid an encrypted audio recorder behind a TV in an executive meeting room. OpenAI says its own models helped trace it back to him.

title: FBI arrests OpenAI employee accused of planting hidden recording device in conference room
summary: It's not clear exactly for what purpose the recording device was used, but FBI director Kash Patel said the scheme was to "capture sensitive communications about the company’s super intelligence technology."

title: Judge orders OpenAI to turn over hiring records in Apple trade secrets case
summary: A federal judge ruled that Apple can access OpenAI's interview materials involving former Apple employees, as well as private messages and testimony from key figures in the case.

title: Most tokenized stock trading on Solana, BNB Chain occurs outside US market hours
summary: Tokenized equities have reached nearly $3.3 billion in value as investors embrace round-the-clock access beyond Wall Street hours.

title: SpaceX and Google both said no. Now his software is riding a SpaceX rocket next to Google’s
summary: Satlyt wants to be the Android of orbital computing, offering open software that works on many companies' satellites, versus SpaceX's closed, all-in-one iPhone-style approach.

title: Anthropic warns ‘AI worms’ may autonomously spread across devices like a virus
summary: Anthropic warned that rogue “AI worms” are months away from the ability to self-replicate and autonomously infect user devices such as home appliances and other internet-connected devices.

title: Meta's New Muse Wonder Finally Puts Zuckerberg in the Frontier AI Race
summary: Meta's new flagship beats GPT-6 Astra and Claude on memory, legal and marathon coding tests, but independent rankings still put Anthropic's Opus 5.5 on top.
